entry.title: A slower moment in a busy day
entry.summary: Both books invite adults to reconsider what can wait and notice opportunities for connection in everyday routines, within real commitments.
entry.cue: When the day feels crowded and every activity seems to need its own time.
detail: Look at what matters to your family and what could be simplified or postponed. In The Montessori Baby, doing your best changes with the day, including how much rest you have had.

Davies acknowledges work, money, and circumstances that cannot simply be changed. She describes finding opportunities during everyday routines or on a weekend, rather than requiring the same day from every family.
A meal, a conversation, or some time together can be part of family life you are already living. The books’ examples offer possibilities, not a schedule to complete.

principle.text: Everyday routines can offer time together.
